ops.body: cc-steer sweep update 2026-07-19: the affordable much-larger arm is refuted — qwen3.6-35b-a3b (MoE 3B-active, ~$19/unit) scored 0.9230 sentinel AUC, LAST behind 9B 0.9371 / 8B 0.9301 / 4B 0.9262 on the uniform Tinker-frame instrument. The 9B therefore remains the sweep winner and this task's decision (mlx-lm LoRA counterpart vs hosted serving) is the live question. cc-steer's W4b spike is measuring the hosted path now: promoted 8B watcher artifact behind a Modal vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, eval-what-you-serve over the frozen frame vs the 0.9291 local baseline. TinkerBackend.sample (0.8.0) remains a candidate backend; the serving decision lands as a cc-steer note after the spike.
